why: Both engineers moved the same client surface, hit the same two real blockers (seed, retired dated ids), and found the same pre-existing anthropic TypeError, but A's system-level work is deeper and more specific to this app: stage-grain spend labels that un-collapse the single dispatcher (B's labels stay at file:function, so ideation, novelty, citations, review and meta-review share one bucket), the n=5 ensemble actually ported off `n` rather than only proposed, a deterministic reflection early exit, and caching measured with the one stage it harms named. A is also more honest about what truly moved — it explicitly contradicts its own scanner on the ensemble and on the DeepSeek/Gemini sites, whereas B wrapped non-routable vendor clients 'to complete the family', which inflates its validation to 7/9 verified with zero unverified, and spent a built slot on a metadata app tag.
A_best: It measured what the scanner got wrong instead of taking credit for it: the n=5 review ensemble is kept on OpenAI as 'untranslatable: n' despite statically reporting as routed, the DeepSeek/Gemini clients never leave their vendors, and then it actually built the ensemble port plus per-stage labels that make 'what did this paper cost, by stage' answerable and let policy target one stage at a time.
B_best: Correctly reasoning that /v1/messages carries no Router policy fields at all — so the default Claude path can get no cache key, fallback or timeout — and proposing the port of that path onto /v1/responses as the structural fix, backed by the cleanest measurement in either report (cache A/B with a ROUTER_MIGRATE_POLICY=off control).
A_worst: It silently folded a real behaviour change into the migration: dropping temperature on the Claude path means the reviewer, the system's own quality gate, is no longer pinned at 0.1 and ideation loses its 0.75 diversity — disclosed, but shipped rather than put to a human — and aider, which it names the biggest spender, remains a proposal.
B_worst: Wrapping the DeepSeek, OpenRouter and Gemini clients that provably cannot route inflates the outside check to 7/9 verified with no unverified sites, and its improvement set is thinner for this app — one built item is just a metadata app tag, spend labels stay at function grain, and the ensemble and reflection loops are left untouched.
